'''Myers''' as a surname has several possible origins, e.g. Old French {{lang|fro|mire}} ("physician"),<ref>{{cite book |last1=Hanks |first1=Patrick |title=Dictionary of American Family Names |date=2003 |publisher=[[Oxford University Press]] |page=641 |isbn=978-0-19-508137-4 |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=vG7MZ9J6dAgC&pg=PA641}}</ref> Old English {{lang|ang|maire}} ("mayor"),{{fact|date=March 2022}} and Old Norse {{lang|non|myrr}} ("marsh").{{fact|date=March 2022}}
